title: Playboy Magazine Lot of 4 1975 1976 1987 1989 La Toya + 1 Special Magazine
descriptionText:
Description:

Lot of 4 vintage Playboy magazines from the 1970s and 1980s.

Includes:

* January 1975 – Holiday Anniversary Issue featuring a John Dean interview and other articles/features. 
* September 1976 – Features Kurt Vonnegut Jr.’s Slapstick, Girls of Washington feature, Watergate article and more
* August 1987 – “Fabulous Paulina” issue
* March 1989 – La Toya Jackson cover and pictorial, plus Tom Hanks interview

Original vintage magazines. Pre-owned condition with normal signs of age and storage, including possible cover wear, scuffs, scratches, edge/corner wear, creasing and discoloration.

Please review all photos carefully for exact condition. Sold together as a lot of 4 magazines exactly as pictured.
